newsitem.title: USA: U.S. heart surgeon DeBakey to visit Russia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. heart surgeon DeBakey to visit Russia.

text.p: Noted heart surgeon Dr. Michael DeBakey said on Saturday he would travel to Russia later this month and in May but he did not plan to consult with former patient Boris Yeltsin while there.
"This month I'm going (to Russia) to receive an award and in May to participate in a symposium. But I do have an open invitation to visit" the Russian president, DeBakey told Reuters.
Late in 1996 DeBakey served as a consultant to a team of surgeons, many of them former students, who performed coronary bypass surgery on Yeltsin.
DeBakey was in Wilmington, Delaware, on Saturday to receive a science award.
